create.name: Jonathan Hammond
create.bio:
Jonathan Hammond is a shamanic practitioner, spiritual teacher and transpersonal counsellor based in Kihei on Maui. Before turning to this work full-time he had a career as an actor on Broadway and in television. He trained in spiritual counselling and interspiritual ministry with the One Spirit Learning Alliance, finished the Foundation for Shamanic Studies' core training, and was ordained as an Alaka'i, or guide, in a Hawaiian shamanic lineage. He also holds certifications in Huna, ho'oponopono and several schools of Reiki, and has learned from shamans in Hawaii, Bali, Brazil, Mexico and Nicaragua.

His teaching rests on an animistic, earth-based view in which nature, spirit and psyche work together, held alongside a grounding in modern psychology, and much of it concerns shamanism and natural magick. He wrote The Shaman's Mind: Huna Wisdom to Change Your Life, which grew out of a workshop he taught at the Omega Institute, and created The Shaman Within, an audio programme of guided shamanic journeys made with Hemi-Sync. He has taught for Omega, The Shift Network, GlideWing and the One Spirit Learning Alliance, and he sees clients in person on Maui and online for spiritual counselling, as well as supervising therapists and healers who bring spirituality into their practice. A second book, Rewilding Consciousness, is due in 2027.

books.title: The Shaman's Mind: Huna Wisdom to Change Your Life
books.author: Jonathan Hammond
books.description: Drawing on the Hawaiian tradition of Huna, Hammond teaches readers to look at their lives the way an indigenous shaman might, working with unseen help and other states of awareness to shift what is happening. The book grew from his Omega workshop of the same name.

courses.title: The Shaman's Mind (online course, GlideWing)
courses.description: A recorded online course with Jonathan, produced by GlideWing and Hemi-Sync, that teaches Huna-based ways of thinking and working like a shaman. Linked from his home page.

courses.title: The Shaman Within (Hemi-Sync audio programme)
courses.description: Six guided journeys set to Hemi-Sync sound, including meeting a spirit guide, a soul retrieval journey, cutting energetic cords and a journey through the chakras.

courses.title: Spiritual & Transpersonal Counselling
courses.description: One-to-one sessions, in person on Maui or online, that bring shamanic and transpersonal perspectives together with psychological insight to work on purpose, patterns and spiritual connection. Packages of four to ten sessions are also offered.

courses.title: Supervision for Healers and Counsellors
courses.description: Professional guidance for therapists, healers and coaches who want to bring spirituality and shamanic depth into their work with care and good judgement.
